description.zh: 图片在云端的存储周期，单位为天。
description.en: The storage duration of pictures in the cloud, in days.

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的**设备**页查看**DeviceName**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The name of the IPC device.
You can view the **DeviceName** on the **Devices** page of the IoT Platform console.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. As the unique identifier of the device, **IotId** has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

description.zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must pass in this ID value. Otherwise, the call will fail.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

description.zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。

您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.

You can view the information of all products under the current account on the **Products** page of the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to query the information.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

title.zh: 设置设备云存储图片生命周期
title.en: Set the lifecycle of device cloud storage pictures

descriptions.zh: > 设置云存储图片生命周期前，默认图片在云端永久存储。
descriptions.en: > Before the lifecycle of cloud storage pictures is set, pictures are stored permanently in the cloud by default.
